purpose: Runtime art of the Segarecomp launcher and the shared in-game viewer, and the audit of the SEG-058 v2 implementation-kit textures. Text is never baked into a texture; panels, buttons, bevels, toggles, sliders and focus rings are drawn in code from the palette below.

background.png.role: the scenery: hero banner (sun, horizon, waterfalls; cover-scaled, 80 % above the horizon so the sun is never cut), the dimmed water behind the window and the foliage frame

wordmark.png.role: SEGARECOMP logotype in the hero and the viewer's page headers

ui/icon-*.png.role: UI icons (tinted, nearest-neighbour upscaled); byte-identical to the kit's textures/icons/*.png

fonts/Silkscreen-Bold.ttf.role: titles, section headings, platform bands and the no-cover tag

covers/placeholder-1..4.png.role: cover placeholders for games without a chosen cover: one of four distinct fictional paintings (coast with loop, sunset bay, night city, jungle temple) picked from the ROM digest, always shown under the platform band and a NO COVER ART tag so it is never mistaken for identified box art
covers/placeholder-1..4.png.source: segarecomp-4-library-placeholders.zip supplied by the project owner (project-owned fictional art; no commercial cover)

removed.ui/cover-placeholder.png: 192x256 procedural placeholder of the first kit; unused at runtime and superseded by covers/placeholder-1..4.png. The cover-import test now uses icon-drop.png as its real PNG.

textures/backgrounds/launcher_header_pan.decision: not shipped: fallback only, and the repository background is available; a smooth 141k-colour render rather than palette pixel art, so it would not match the nearest-neighbour UI

textures/backgrounds/launcher_page_fallb.decision: not shipped: same reasons; the page background is composed from background.png

textures/backgrounds/sunset_strip_fallba.decision: not shipped: superseded by the kit itself and by the repository art

textures/chrome/*, textures/buttons/*, t.decision: not shipped: the same shapes are drawn in code at any scale (nine-slice insets of 8 px would blur or step at the launcher's fractional HiDPI scales); colours match the palette above

references/*.png.decision: review material only, never runtime art; not committed

textures/covers/cover_placeholder*.png.decision: superseded by the owner-supplied set of four distinct placeholders now shipped as covers/placeholder-1..4.png (the v2 kit's four were one image)

packaging: packaging/install.cmake installs this directory into <package>/assets (README.md, this manifest and the font licence excluded; the licence ships in licenses/). The viewer reads wordmark.png and ui/icon-*.png through SEGARECOMP_ASSETS or the package layout.
